Root

It plays by itself once it is on. Drag a knob up or down; what it changes shows on the screen.

The guide: every page, knob and button.

The panel is the FM-1's own, at its real proportions: grey is what is printed on the device, green is what it does in AURORA. Every button does something; the knobs' names follow the page that is open. On a phone, turn it sideways, or use the phone layout: the same controls, bigger.

ALGORITHM
the scene
SELECT
the scale
PRESETS
the root note; or hold SCL and press a key
KNOB 1–4
the four of the page that is open
HOME · Sky
DENSITY · BRIGHT · SPACE · DRIFT. The aurora alone
HOME again · Mix
MIX 1: PADS · BELLS · CHOIR · DRONE; MIX 2 (HOME a third time): WIND · LAKE · LOONS · DRUMS (0: off). Columns of light rise from the lake
FX · Effects
ECHO · CHIMES (how often bells ring) · TIME · TONE (the echo's)
FX again · Night
WAVES · CALLS (loons) · SWELLS (the machine's choir) · SLEEP (15–120 min). Fireflies; a moon sets as the timer runs
ENV · Pad shape
ATTACK · RELEASE · LENGTH · KEYS (how fast the keys' notes swell in). The envelope across the sky
EDIT · Pad tone
WAVE · DETUNE · RESO · SHIMMER. The waveform on the horizon
LFO · Motion
RATE · SWEEP · WIDTH · TREMOLO. Ribbons of movement
GLO · Drone
TONE · FIFTH · SUB · BREATH. Rings rising from the horizon
SEQ · Machine
CHORDS · RANGE · VOICES · EVOLVE. The scale as a constellation
SCL tap
the keys: PADS, HOLD (a key latches), BELLS, CHOIR (real singers)
ARP · Drums
TEMPO · TONE · BUSY · SWING. MIX 2's DRUMS up from 0 starts them; ARP again (or 8 again) rolls a new pattern
Play · Freeze
the machine plays or waits · the reverb and the sky turn to ice
Save
tap: keep it all for next time · hold + F, G, A or B (the first four white keys): keep a moment; HOME + that key brings it back. Here: Alt+Shift+1–4 keeps, Alt+1–4 brings back

Computer keyboard: Z–/ S–' Q–O the keys · 1–8 the pages · Tab SCL · ← → scene · ↑ ↓ scale · Space play · Shift freeze · Enter the drums' page

No sound on an iPhone? Turn the ring/silent switch to ring.

AURORA is free software (GPL-3.0), built on GR!MM's platform, DSP and reverb, which stand on Felucca, Dinghy, SLOOP and X0X. The choir is made from VocalSet (Wilkins, Seetharaman, Wahl, Pardo, Northwestern University, 2018; CC BY 4.0). The screen font is Terminus (SIL OFL 1.1). Unofficial firmware, not made or endorsed by M-VAVE.
